description: Search 40M+ items in the Internet Archive — books, movies, audio, software, images, and archived web pages. Filter by mediatype (texts/movies/audio/software/image/data/web) and creator. Returns identifier, title, creator, date, and description for each match (Internet Archive advancedsearch.php)

mediatype.description: Filter by item type: texts (books/docs), movies, audio, software, image, data, web (archived sites), collection

query.description: Full-text search query across title, description, and text (e.g. "moon landing 1969"). Omit to browse by mediatype/creator alone

rows.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

name: archiveorg.archive.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Internet Archive
